All 12 migrations are frozen history. Every occurrence in code is the internal name matching the DB column.

**About 1082 occurrences across 94 files** — mostly repo/service/route layers in five services, all safe to rename together.

Four spots must stay `account_id`:

| Location | Reason |
|---|---|
| All 12 files in `migrations/` | Already applied in prod, editing breaks the down step |
| `docs/openapi.yaml` | Public API contract, frozen field name |
| `lib/serialize.js` `WIRE` map | Internal-to-public mapping, right side is the wire contract |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk/**` | Vendored third-party code, overwritten on refresh |

`lib/audit.js` uses `account_id` as a JS property tied to the DB row, safe to rename with the rest.

Next: rename in the five `services/*` trees and `lib/audit.js` only, leave the four frozen spots untouched.
